name: Invoices for clients
intro: Where the invoice reaches the client and payment status is visible, and where sync falls apart.

apps.title: Zoho Invoice Maker App
apps.verdict: Zoho Invoice is free with no cap on the number of invoices and grows with your business: when you need more, the path to Zoho Books is smooth. PDFs look clean and professional without any configuration. Weak spots: no deposit field, the timer breaks when you use the app and the web at the same time, and template customization is minimal.
apps.loved: Completely free with no invoice limits, clean PDF output, and a direct migration path to Zoho Books when you outgrow it.
apps.weak: No deposit payment field, the timer conflicts when running both the mobile and desktop clients simultaneously, and template customization is very limited.
apps.whoFor: Early-stage entrepreneurs and solo operators who need a professional-looking invoice without paying for a subscription.

quotes.text: It looks like I can only email the invoice to my customers but I really need to text them too
I don't see a line for down payment
Like the app but the Timer is so broken in the new update. I constantly wants to cancel existing times when I try to start or pause the timer. Might be a IOS widget integration issue.

apps.title: Estimate Maker for Contractors
apps.verdict: The best tool in its class for contractors who need to put together a professional estimate on-site, fast. Fully free for estimates. Editing after creation and integration with other software are limited.
apps.loved: Professional-looking documents without any setup, logo support, faster than any MS Office template according to users who made the switch, and completely free for the basic use case.
apps.weak: Editing a saved estimate is awkward sending to Adobe opens the old version. No real integration with external systems like QuickBooks. The client-facing total sometimes differs from what the contractor sees in the app.
apps.whoFor: Builders, repair contractors, and field service pros who write up proposals on-site and don't need full accounting.

quotes.text: I found this app after searching a long while and it has helped me finish going completely paperless. Love it and I was able to put my own logo on the letter head

apps.title: Harvest: Track Time & Invoice
apps.verdict: Harvest is a mature tool for anyone who bills by the hour: timer to project to invoice runs like a pipeline. Desktop and browser are reliable. The mobile app lost ground after being rewritten in React Native: the timer glitches, entries get lost, and reports and estimates are only available in the browser.
apps.loved: The timer-to-project-to-invoice flow works without manually copying data. Reporting is flexible and clear. Support helps you structure projects and tasks to match non-standard billing arrangements.
apps.weak: The mobile timer sometimes shows a stale value and hitting Start overwrites previous entries. Estimates are not available in the app only through the website. No Live Activity or Dynamic Island support to show a running timer in the background.
apps.whoFor: Freelancers and small agencies who bill by the hour: designers, consultants, developers.

quotes.text: For me, the best part of this service occurs on the back end, tallying the hours logged using the app. You can log your hours thru the web or the iPhone app, and then feed that info into your projects and ultimately into your invoices.

apps.title: Invoice Generator - Zoho
apps.verdict: Zoho Invoice Generator is a free invoice maker from Zoho, which is itself a strong market position. It handles the basics: line items, tax, PDF, sending. Downsides: you can't split tax rates on a single invoice (for example, different rates for goods and labor), the item list doesn't support deactivating entries (only a workaround in settings), and there's no client signature field. Sharing the PDF directly to WhatsApp requires an extra step.
apps.loved: Completely free with no invoice cap, clean PDF output, and quick to start without entering a card.
apps.weak: A single tax rate applies to the whole invoice you can't set different rates for goods and services in the same document.
apps.whoFor: Freelancers and small contractors who need a free tool with no subscription and no complexity.

quotes.text: I'd give it higher rating if there was a place to use my business logo
It's easy to generate invoices but the inability to delete items once you've billed for them starts to make for a very cluttered 'items' list if you have a lot of one-offs.

It's still a great app if your line items are either taxable or non-taxable, but you can't have merchandise and labor items on the same invoice. Because the tax rate is applied AFTER the subtotal and tax is applied to both labor and merchandise items, it's a non-starter for me.

apps.title: HoneyBook - Small Business CRM
apps.verdict: HoneyBook builds the entire client journey inside one document: quote, contract, invoice, and signature are all bundled into a smart file. Automatic payment reminders remove manual follow-up. The problem is that the mobile app is a stripped-down view editing smart files and lead forms can only be done on desktop, and opening a project in iOS frequently shows a blank screen.
apps.loved: Smart files combine contract, invoice, and client signature in one flow, contract templates with a solid structure built in, automatic payment reminders.
apps.weak: The mobile app doesn't let you edit smart files or forms anything complex requires a browser. Blank screens when opening a project in iOS, and the menu disappears behind the keyboard.
apps.whoFor: Photographers, event planners, and designers who sell through a contract-plus-invoice flow and manage several projects at once.

apps.title: Freebie Estimate Maker App
apps.verdict: A solid tool for putting together estimates on-site quickly it's free and looks professional. The main problem is that saved edits sometimes don't make it into the sent document, which creates real risk for contractors.
apps.loved: Free access with no cap on the number of estimates. Builders and contractors can put together a proposal right on the job site. Clean PDF output without visual clutter.
apps.weak: Editing a finished estimate doesn't reliably update the sent PDF several users have sent clients outdated versions with wrong prices. No client signature, no SMS sending, and no cross-device sync without upgrading to paid Billdu.
apps.whoFor: Contractors and builders who need to generate an estimate in the field and send it to the client right away.

quotes.text: This is my first time using I tried to send out to customer but did not have there email address. It does not allow to send via text also maybe a clients signature would be nice to add not sure if it does on invoice part.

apps.title: Tiny Invoice - Invoice Maker
apps.verdict: Tiny Invoice has worked reliably for years without surprise changes that stability is its main selling point. It includes P&L and quarterly tax tracking. Problems surface during major updates: saved line items have disappeared after some updates, and iPhone-to-iPad sync has broken so badly that data only lived on one device.
apps.loved: Stable behavior with no unexpected interface changes, P&L and quarterly taxes in one place, fast invoice creation from saved items.
apps.weak: Some updates have wiped saved line items, iPhone and iPad sync has historically broken, and you can't add a second user to one account.
apps.whoFor: Solo entrepreneurs and micro-businesses who value stability and don't want to learn a new tool.

quotes.text: Half my e mails go to junk mail an I'm constantly following up with customers who say they didn't receive an e mail.

I've been using Tiny Invoice for my business gor years and overall the app is well designed we love it. However, I recently experienced a serious syncing issue between my iPhone and iPad. The devices stopped syncing invoices and estimates correctly, and some data existed only on one device.

apps.title: Wave: Small Business Software
apps.verdict: Wave used to be the gold standard for free small-business accounting, but after a monetization pivot most features moved behind a paywall. The remaining free tier is too thin for real work. The desktop version is significantly more capable than the mobile app.
apps.loved: Invoice and estimate creation works well: professional PDFs, built-in late-payment reminders for clients, and a notification when a client opens an invoice. Accountants note that the bookkeeping logic is cleaner and more correct than QuickBooks.
apps.weak: The mobile app is a stripped-down shell: account balances are unavailable without desktop, and categorizing transactions requires scrolling the entire list from the top after each save. Bank transaction sync breaks periodically and support goes quiet.
apps.whoFor: Freelancers and micro-businesses who need integrated bookkeeping and invoicing in one place and are okay working mostly through a browser.

quotes.text: My main reason for using this is all is because it would notify you of when clients open your estimates and invoices. Now it has stopped working so not worth it for me anymore

apps.title: Billdu: Invoice Estimate Maker
apps.verdict: Billdu is the most feature-complete of the compact invoice makers: it handles both invoices and estimates, supports multiple templates, and works for multilingual markets. But there's a long-standing bug that hasn't been fixed in years: the client's name disappears from a saved invoice or estimate when you edit it. This breaks the core use case. Splitting invoice vs. estimate access across plan tiers without warning is a product trap.
apps.loved: Flexible branded templates, fast estimate creation with one-tap conversion to invoice, multilingual interface.
apps.weak: The client's name randomly disappears from the invoice or estimate whenever you edit it a bug that has been around for years with no fix.
apps.whoFor: Small contractors and freelancers who need branded templates and estimate workflows.

quotes.text: If you have an issue an AI bot is there to help you and then disconnect from the conversation without warning. I paid for a yearly subscription only to find out I can only do invoices not estimates but for some extra cash I could.
My invoices are losing customer names and costing me money and time.

apps.title: Square Invoices: Invoice Maker
apps.verdict: Square Invoices wins on the built-in payment rail: the invoice goes out and the money lands in the same place. QuickBooks integration works. Product gaps remain: you can't delete a created invoice, there are no fractional units in line items, and there's no receipt screen after payment.
apps.loved: Built-in invoice status tracking with a view history visible to you, and a unified ecosystem with the Square terminal and bank account.
apps.weak: No way to delete an invoice created by mistake, which constantly distorts your accounts receivable balance. No fractional values in the quantity field.
apps.whoFor: Small businesses already processing payments through Square who want to keep everything in one place.

quotes.text: This app has been amazing and makes I Big difference as far as organization goes. No more trying to keep track of who has paid and who hasn't and also allows you to keep track of all the work you have yet ahead.

One thing I don't like about Square invoices is that they're not very transparent when it comes to payment timing. Once I send an invoice, I never really know when I'll get paid, which makes it harder to plan and manage cash flow.

apps.title: Freebie Invoice Maker
apps.verdict: Freebie wins on speed of getting started: minimal fields, straight to business, clean PDF out the other end. Two mechanical barriers though: after 5 invoices you can only edit old ones with a subscription, and the anti-fraud system can block invoice creation mid-session with a client no explanation and no way to unblock on the spot.
apps.loved: Very low barrier to entry the first invoice is ready in a minute, and the output is clean without extra elements.
apps.weak: The anti-fraud system blocks sending without explanation right while you're working with a client. After 5 invoices, old ones become inaccessible for editing without a subscription.
apps.whoFor: Occasional and infrequent businesses tradespeople, couriers, freelancers with a light invoice volume.

apps.title: Easy Invoice Maker App
apps.verdict: Easy Invoice Maker is simple and fast for the basic case. It supports multiple service types (lawn care, handyman work) with separate tax rates uncommon flexibility. But: landscape mode was removed in an update (iPad users are frustrated), logos sometimes don't show up on the client's end, and there's no way to export a period report to PDF or Excel for tax purposes. The built-in mechanism for collecting five-star reviews using AI-generated text is a reputational risk.
apps.loved: Multiple service types with different tax rates on one invoice, and an intuitive interface with no unnecessary steps.
apps.weak: Landscape mode was removed in an update, breaking the workflow for iPad users. No summary report export for tax purposes.
apps.whoFor: Self-employed workers with multiple service types (like lawn care and repairs) who need a simple invoice with split tax rates.

quotes.text: Loved this app until I realized my logo isn't showing on the clients side and when I print it out, had no problems up until a couple weeks ago and nothing seems to be working.

I like it, but, it would be nice to have a way to generate a report to pdf. or excel for tax purposes. I do different invoices for lawn care and handyman services where I have to charge tax for the lawn care services. It would make life so much easier If I could separate the taxed invoices from the non-taxed.

apps.title: Invoice Maker ▸ Estimate App
apps.verdict: Invoice Maker and Estimate App handles the basic estimate-to-invoice flow from a phone. Functionally limited: no web access, no quarterly report filtering, and no auto-save on switch. Client signature on estimates is not supported, which matters for the construction segment.
apps.loved: Estimate and invoice in one flow: send a quote, client accepts, convert to invoice without retyping anything.
apps.weak: If you switch to another app mid-invoice (for example, to look up an address on a map), the unsaved invoice is gone completely.
apps.whoFor: Tradespeople and small contractors who need an estimate-to-invoice chain without extra steps.

quotes.text: I use the free version great for making a quick invoice if you don't mind the watermark. But often when I try to create an invoice it just spins and spins, and it doesn't work unless I delete the app and reinstall it. Also no button to convert a quote to an invoice.
I was bummed when they started charging, but since I was so dependent on the free free version I had to pay. I wish they incorporated a way to seamlessly accept down payments.
When receiving partial payment invoice should update better, also payouts are very difficult.
Would recommend a way to save descriptions in the tasks for any that are used frequently, and ways to accept signatures for estimates by customers. Would stream line writing estimates.
Been buggy since they switched over to subscription. Currently been unable to update invoice prefix and number sequence…

Please explain what Settings - Other - Reset & Indexes does? Will I lose my previous Company Profile / data and Clients / Products that I set up? Will the Invoice numbers reset and allow me to select a new starting sequence?

apps.title: Invoice Maker & Estimate App
apps.verdict: The app has real depth: photos attached to individual line items, signature on delivery, and multiple send channels. But estimate-to-invoice conversion in one tap still hasn't shipped, and there's no deposit payment mechanism that carries over to the final invoice contractors with multi-stage payments have to do it by hand.
apps.loved: A photo on each line item builds client confidence by showing exactly what they're paying for, multiple send channels, and a signature-on-delivery feature.
apps.weak: No deposit payment that rolls into the final invoice, no convert-estimate-to-invoice button, and payment gateway data sometimes conflicts with the user's own settings.
apps.whoFor: Contractors and service businesses with straightforward single-stage billing who want to show clients photos of the completed work.

quotes.text: I use the free version great for making a quick invoice if you don't mind the watermark. But often when I try to create an invoice it just spins and spins, and it doesn't work unless I delete the app and reinstall it. Also no button to convert a quote to an invoice.
I was bummed when they started charging, but since I was so dependent on the free free version I had to pay. I wish they incorporated a way to seamlessly accept down payments.
When receiving partial payment invoice should update better, also payouts are very difficult.
Would recommend a way to save descriptions in the tasks for any that are used frequently, and ways to accept signatures for estimates by customers. Would stream line writing estimates.
Been buggy since they switched over to subscription. Currently been unable to update invoice prefix and number sequence…

Please explain what Settings - Other - Reset & Indexes does? Will I lose my previous Company Profile / data and Clients / Products that I set up? Will the Invoice numbers reset and allow me to select a new starting sequence?

apps.title: FreeMaker - Invoice Maker
apps.verdict: The app creates invoices quickly and cleanly new users get up to speed in minutes. The main issue: after introducing a hard paywall (5 invoices a year free, then up to £165 per year), loyal users felt the rules had changed on them. Landscape mode on iPad has been broken for several months.
apps.loved: Invoice creation speed: logo, line items, total, PDF all in a few taps. The result looks professional without tweaking any templates.
apps.weak: Editing an already-sent invoice does not update the document on the client's end you have to screenshot and resend manually. iPad in landscape mode with a keyboard doesn't work. A limit of 5 invoices a year makes the free tier pointless.
apps.whoFor: Freelancers and micro-contractors with a small client flow who need a polished PDF invoice in two minutes and are willing to pay for a subscription.

apps.title: Invoice & Estimate Maker
apps.verdict: The app handles basic invoicing and recurring billing for regular clients. A critical problem: data doesn't sync between devices on the same account an invoice created on your phone isn't accessible on your tablet. There's no credit note for processing returns, so reversing a line item has to be done manually.
apps.loved: Recurring billing for regular clients, template selection, and fast invoice creation from saved items.
apps.weak: Data doesn't sync between devices on the same Apple ID, no credit note for returns, and no way to log in from a laptop.
apps.whoFor: Service businesses with repeat clients who work from a single phone.

quotes.text: I'm capable of generating professional estimates & invoices on this app and that's so awesome. I wish I was able to logon to my account from different devices. Currently I'm logged on to my account from cell phone but I'm unable to logon to the my account from my laptop or my iPad.
Tax is not working, is not calculating when add the percentage they use to work but now it doesn't
Awesome templates to choose and customize! My only request is that they make it where you can choose between a PO# and a WO# on an invoice. I have clients that use both

apps.title: Invoice Maker - Invoice Fly
apps.verdict: Invoice Fly is a straightforward mobile invoice app with a clean interface and a few templates. It works for the basic case, but the key feature sending a PDF by email is locked behind a subscription from the very first action. Cloud sync is unreliable: switch phones and your history is gone.
apps.loved: Several invoice layout options, fast client entry after the first save.
apps.weak: Data doesn't sync reliably in the cloud switching devices means losing everything. No web version for working from a laptop.
apps.whoFor: Self-employed people who occasionally need to send an invoice from their phone and are fine with a single screen and no complexity.

apps.title: Invoice2go: Easy Invoice Maker
apps.verdict: Invoice2go does what's needed: fast invoicing, saved clients, saved items and rates, and a viewed status. But the app doesn't save a draft when you go to the background you lose whatever you've typed. The built-in payment processing has had issues: frozen funds and cases of unauthorized charges. That's a product-level risk, not noise.
apps.loved: Line item and rate autocomplete from history speeds up repeat invoices, and status tracking (sent, viewed, paid).
apps.weak: Invoice drafts don't auto-save when you switch apps, which is critical when working in the field and toggling between a map and the invoice form.
apps.whoFor: Contractors and tradespeople who invoice regularly and want to see history by client.

quotes.text: Easy to make invoices and just as easy to keep track of when they are seen by costumers as well as when they are payed.
Super easy to bill on the go. Easy to navigate, saves clients for repeat business. Saves pricing for any items or tasks. Saves labor and material rates. Even adds tax if necessary.

apps.title: Invoice Simple: Invoice Maker
apps.verdict: Invoice Simple does one thing well: a quick invoice from your phone with an SMS notification to the client. A loyal base built up over 6+ years, but the product has been monetized aggressively: the price has tripled and the limit has shrunk to 3 invoices per month on a paid plan. That's not a bug it's a product decision that destroys value for small businesses.
apps.loved: SMS invoice delivery to the client directly from the app a rare feature that speeds up closing the deal on the spot.
apps.weak: The invoice limit is tied to your plan and can drop without warning after an update. PDF and email sending occasionally break entirely and require a reinstall.
apps.whoFor: Mobile tradespeople (tire shops, mobile services) who need to send an invoice by text right from the job.

quotes.text: I would recommend Invoice Simple to anybody who has a business or starting out. I'm a tire mobile installer and been looking for an Invoice company where I can send my customers immediate pricing etc. most company don't offer SMS text messaging only by email but Invoice does.

App is great just would be better if there was a way to add different options to estimates. For example different options for the customer to select on the estimate. I do HVAC and to send 3 different estimates is a pain.

Why are you using a company for our payouts that we are not able to communicate with? Stripe is always slow, late and not user friendly. Some people can't use PayPal so I'm sending them square links or Zelle.

apps.title: Joist: Estimate Invoice Maker
apps.verdict: Joist lets you attach your license and insurance to your profile clients see the documents right inside the app. Online and in-person payment acceptance works. But the monetization model undercuts the value: features are steadily moved to more expensive tiers, and after a subscription lapses, access to your own documents is locked until you pay again.
apps.loved: Showing license and insurance to the client inside the app, online and in-person payment acceptance, estimate history with change tracking.
apps.weak: Features keep moving to pricier tiers without new capabilities being added. The document archive closes after you cancel you pay for access to content you already created.
apps.whoFor: Construction contractors and remodelers who need to show their license to clients and accept payment on-site.

quotes.text: The Joist investment invoice maker I have been using for years. It's a very nice app to use. I have recommended this other contractors to use the downfall to Joist. Is that not only do they charge a fee but they sent it to a third-party for payment payments to charge an additional fee.
I been using joist for a month and it's great. Easy to make invoices, easy for customers to sign, make payments. I enjoy using this app!

apps.title: Intuit QuickBooks for Business
apps.verdict: QuickBooks is a full accounting system, not an invoice maker. It's not really the right fit for this niche: users come for tax accounting and integrations, not for fast invoice creation. The mobile client is degrading: constant freezes on load, a broken expense module, and a black camera screen for receipts. The invoicing piece works, but it's wrapped inside a heavy ERP with an unstable app.
apps.loved: Sync with the web version lets you close a deal in the field and invoice immediately. Bank integration speeds up payment reconciliation.
apps.weak: The expense module was rewritten so the old flow (photo a receipt, log the expense) is now split into two steps with a wait for AI processing. Some vendors don't load in the dropdown (only A through F).
apps.whoFor: Accountants and small businesses that need full bookkeeping with tax reporting, not just an invoicing tool.

apps.title: FreshBooks Invoicing App
apps.verdict: FreshBooks offers a useful set of features: a time tracker that feeds hours directly into invoices, receipt scanning with auto-categorization, and mileage tracking. In practice, the mobile app doesn't sync with the web clients see a different total in the PDF than what the user sees in the app. Mileage tracking records roughly one trip in ten. Face ID doesn't persist between sessions.
apps.loved: Time tracker with direct billing integration, receipt scanning with auto-categorization, and a solid foundation for small-business tax reporting.
apps.weak: The mobile app and web show different data for the same invoice. Mileage tracking is unreliable (catches about 10% of trips). The session resets every time you open the app despite the Remember This Device setting.
apps.whoFor: Freelancers and consultants who sell time and want to track hours inside the same tool they use to invoice.

quotes.text: I love the time tracker and invoice function. The only problem I have is that when I upload receipts and add those to an invoice, there is no automated bank reconciliation.

apps.title: Invoice Maker・Billing App
apps.verdict: The app supports multiple legal entities in one account and revenue reports those are real working features. But the basics are broken: Face ID doesn't persist between sessions, the amount separator prints 150,00 instead of 150.00, and data doesn't sync between devices. These bugs have been present for years without a fix.
apps.loved: Multiple legal entities in one account, revenue reports, and reasonably fast invoice creation once you learn the flow.
apps.weak: Every launch requires logging in again Face ID doesn't hold. The decimal separator is wrong (comma instead of period). Data doesn't sync between devices on the same account.
apps.whoFor: Entrepreneurs running multiple sole proprietorships or legal entities who can tolerate technical rough edges.

quotes.text: When I try to open the app in another device it doesn't show all the invoices,items and costumers.

apps.title: Invoice Maker・Estimate App
apps.verdict: The app breaks regularly on basic operations: the invoice preview shows a green screen, documents won't open or send, and data disappears after logging out. Some reviews were written before users had even used the app, which is visible in the text.
apps.loved: The interface looks clean and the onboarding flow is clear even for first-timers. When it works, it puts together an invoice quickly.
apps.weak: Data is unreliable: invoices disappear after logout, and files arrive corrupted. The app asks for a review before giving access to any features. No proper export or sync.
apps.whoFor: Hard to recommend given the current instability.

quotes.text: I use the free version great for making a quick invoice if you don't mind the watermark. But often when I try to create an invoice it just spins and spins, and it doesn't work unless I delete the app and reinstall it. Also no button to convert a quote to an invoice.
I was bummed when they started charging, but since I was so dependent on the free free version I had to pay. I wish they incorporated a way to seamlessly accept down payments.
When receiving partial payment invoice should update better, also payouts are very difficult.
Would recommend a way to save descriptions in the tasks for any that are used frequently, and ways to accept signatures for estimates by customers. Would stream line writing estimates.
Been buggy since they switched over to subscription. Currently been unable to update invoice prefix and number sequence…

Please explain what Settings - Other - Reset & Indexes does? Will I lose my previous Company Profile / data and Clients / Products that I set up? Will the Invoice numbers reset and allow me to select a new starting sequence?

apps.title: Invoice Maker App -InvoiceBase
apps.verdict: Templates look attractive, but the product fails on basic mechanics: the description disappears from a sent invoice, logos and signatures don't save, and switching phones means losing the account and all data. Support doesn't respond.
apps.loved: Visually clean invoice templates and quick start without creating an account.
apps.weak: Line item descriptions disappear from the sent document even when the in-app preview looks correct. No data transfer between devices (Android to iPhone is not possible). The tax rate field is capped at three characters you can't enter 9.975%. Support ignores messages.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended until the app fixes its core breakage.

scenarios.name: Contractors and builders
scenarios.job: Draw up an estimate right on the job site and send it straight away, before the client cools off. Then convert it into an invoice without retyping.

scenarios.name: Freelancers and consultants
scenarios.job: Invoice for hours or for a project, track the payment status, and not keep a separate accounting tool.

scenarios.name: Mobile service technicians
scenarios.job: Issue the invoice right after finishing the job, at the client’s home. Get paid on the spot or send a link by text. No fiddling with a computer.

scenarios.name: Micro retail and cleaning
scenarios.job: Run regular billing for repeat clients, separate service types with different tax rates, and pull the period’s figures together for the tax office.
